$comment: Enemies that wander in for the knight to fight. Clips come from the exported vanilla libraries in data/hk/animations (enemy art is always vanilla: skins/Vanilla; every enemy's art faces left and is mirrored to face right). `moves`: ground (walks / crawls along ledges, walks in from a monitor edge when its ledge reaches one, else drops in) or fly (flies in from the nearer side edge to hover `hover` units over a ledge). Clips: idle, move, turn (once, then mirrored), startle (once, on noticing the knight), chase (default: move), antic + attack + recover (a lunge that moves `lunge` units/s), fall (dropping in), death_air (struck dead, thrown back), death_land (lying dead; fades after a moment). `hp`: blows it takes (spells count more). `speed` / `chase_speed`: game units/s. `aggro`: notices the knight this close (game units; 0 = never, a harmless crawler that only bumps into him). `reach`: starts its attack this close. `size`: body [w, h] in game units (blows, contact, where the knight stands). `geo`: [min, max] burst when killed. `stay`: seconds it roams before wandering off if nobody fights it. `weight` (default 1): how often it is the one that wanders in; 0 = never (the Grub Mimic only bursts out of a grub jar that held no grub, dropping from where the jar stood; it doesn't count for "every kind of enemy"). `schedule`: like npcs.json `visits` (presence-time countdown; never during fullscreen apps, fast typing, or while a visitor is around). `rules`: `max_alive` at once, a visit brings `group` [min, max] of them, `stagger` seconds apart. The bored knight can also ask for one (world event). `gauntlet`: the arena event, waves of enemies and a reward (see its own `$comment`).

gauntlet.$comment: An arena event on the knight's monitor (like the game's arenas / Colosseum trials): the knight readies himself ("!" and his `challenge` bow) for `announce` s, then `waves` arrive one after another, each only once the previous one is cleared and after a `breather` [min, max] s. A wave brings `count` [min, max] enemies picked from `mix` (enemy name: weight), `stagger` s apart, arriving like any enemy (settled, reachable ledges; never on a game's monitor); they don't wander off for `hold` s. Completed: a `reward` [min, max] Geo burst by the knight and his `victory` (`cheer` s). It ends early (the enemies wander off, nothing is lost) when the user types at least `busy_keys_per_sec` for `busy_secs`, a fullscreen app or a visitor appears, the knight dies or is hurt above `hurt` (0..1) or backs off, a wave takes over `max_wave_secs`, or there is no room for an arrival for `no_room_secs`. It never starts during another fight, a visitor, a fullscreen app or fast typing; a gauntlet that can't start waits up to `wait` s. `natural`: on its own once he has beaten `after_kills` single enemies, each further kill rolls `chance`; at most once per `cooldown` s. Or on request: "Start a gauntlet" in the tray / panel.
